purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry access review.
assessment: City InterSIT documents the professional WFS for EGiB parcel geometry and identifiers. Anonymous WFS 2.0.0 capabilities/schema succeeded. A one-meter EPSG:3857 bbox query around the exact unchanged WUP point requested only ID_DZIALKI and msGeometry and returned ID_DZIALKI=106105_9.0006.98/1; point-in-polygon confirmed containment. An earlier 100m EPSG:3857 query returned three IDs (106105_9.0006.94/1, 106105_9.0006.93/1, 106105_9.0006.93/4); these are documented but their polygons are not retained.
registryAssessment: Łódź City’s official InterSIT Geoportal describes the city’s EGiB database and its professional WFS as including cadastral parcel geometry and identifier. The WFS GetCapabilities/DescribeFeatureType and one tightly bounded query were successfully inspected. One source parcel contains the exact WUP point. The record verifies a sample at that point, not citywide completeness.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official City Geoportal states the map depicts the county-level EGiB database.
Official InterSIT page documents WFS geometry and identifier for registered parcels and publishes service endpoint.
Official English InterSIT professional page documents the same WFS parcel geometry/identifier service.
Anonymous WFS endpoint used for capabilities, schema and bounded query.

attempts.result: Capabilities: WFS 2.0.0; feature type ms:dzialki; default CRS EPSG:2177 and requested response CRS EPSG:3857. DescribeFeatureType confirms native ID field ID_DZIALKI and geometry msGeometry. Supported requested output was application/gml+xml; version=3.2 (GML 3.2.1). One 1m EPSG:3857 bbox query around the exact WUP point with COUNT=3 and PROPERTYNAME=ms:ID_DZIALKI,ms:msGeometry returned one polygon. Polygon was transformed to RFC7946 WGS84 for the retained sample; source-native ID preserved slash. Earlier 100m bbox query returned three nearby safe IDs recorded above, but no extra geometries retained. No owner/address or other attributes were requested.
